pressure_note: 0.6 MPa (title: at 0.6 MPa); pressures accurate to +-50 kPa
extra_unmapped: 10^2 x [(cp rho/cp1* rho1*) - 1] (dimensionless, printed x 1e-2; measured volume heat capacity ratio minus 1 at T2; moved from value2 because the builder reads value2 as absolute density)
title_as_printed: Experimental Values of the Quantities [(cp rho/cp,1* rho1*) - 1], (rho - rho1*), Cp,2,phi, and V2,phi for the Binary Solutions NaCl(aq), MgCl2(aq), and CaCl2(aq) at 0.6 MPa

footnotes_as_printed.a: a is the ratio of the volume heat capacity of the solution to that of water; (rho - rho1*) is the difference between the density of the solution and that of water; Cp,2,phi is the apparent molar heat capacity; V2,phi is the apparent molar volume.

T2.note: temperature belonging to value2 and the heat capacity columns

value.what: density of solution minus density of pure water at the same T and P (water reference values from Haar et al. 1983)

composition.other_species: pure water solvent; single salt per block
